name: Apache Hadoop and the Big Data Ecosystem
certifications: Cloudera Certified CDP Administrator - Private Cloud Base

beginner.summary: For data engineers, administrators and developers who work with on-premises big data platforms. Covers the Hadoop ecosystem and a lab cluster, HDFS architecture and commands, YARN, MapReduce in Java and Python, Hive tables, partitions and file formats, moving data in and out, HBase, Spark on YARN, scheduling, ZooKeeper, cluster configuration, monitoring with Ambari or Cloudera Manager, security in brief, SQL engines and Hadoop services in the cloud.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Linux commands and SQL
Basic programming in Java or Python
Understands files, directories and networks at a basic level
outcomes: Explain how Hadoop stores and processes data
Load, query and process data with HDFS, MapReduce, Hive, HBase and Spark
Configure, monitor and secure a small cluster
Choose between on-premises and cloud Hadoop services

days.topic: Hadoop Overview, Ecosystem and Lab Cluster Setup
subtopics: Why Hadoop was built and where it is still used
The core: HDFS, YARN and MapReduce
The wider ecosystem: Hive, HBase, Spark, Kafka and more
Running a lab cluster with Docker or virtual machines
Web interfaces for HDFS and YARN
Hadoop compared with cloud data lakes
The course project: web log analytics
days.lab_task: Start a three-node lab cluster with Docker, check the HDFS and YARN web interfaces, run the sample word count job and sketch the log analytics project.
days.deliverable: Running lab cluster and project sketch
checks: All DataNodes and NodeManagers shown as live
Data sources, stages and outputs listed

days.topic: HDFS Architecture: NameNode, DataNodes and Blocks
days.lab_task: Upload a large file, find where its blocks and replicas live, stop a DataNode and watch re-replication, and put the cluster into and out of safe mode.
checks: Block locations listed for the file
Missing replicas re-created on other nodes
Writes blocked in safe mode and resumed after

days.topic: Working with HDFS: Shell Commands and File Operations
days.lab_task: Organise a raw, clean and curated folder structure in HDFS, set permissions and quotas, recover a deleted file from trash and copy data to a second cluster with DistCp.

days.topic: YARN: Resource Management and Applications
days.lab_task: Submit several jobs, follow them through the YARN UI, read aggregated logs for a failed job, kill a runaway application and explain how memory is allocated.
checks: Jobs followed from submission to completion
Cause of the failed job found in aggregated logs

days.topic: MapReduce Concepts and a First Job
days.lab_task: Trace the map, shuffle and reduce stages of a word count job with counters, change the number of reducers and explain the effect on output files.
checks: Map and reduce record counts explained

days.topic: Writing MapReduce Jobs in Java
days.lab_task: Write a Java MapReduce job that counts requests per URL and status code from web logs, skips bad records with a counter, test it locally and run it on the cluster.
checks: Counts per URL and status produced
Unit tests pass before cluster runs

days.topic: MapReduce with Python Using Hadoop Streaming
subtopics: Sorting and grouping in streaming jobs
days.lab_task: Rewrite the log analysis in Python with Hadoop Streaming, ship a lookup file with the job, debug a failing mapper and compare run time with the Java version.
checks: Lookup file used by the mapper

days.topic: Apache Hive: Tables, Partitions and HiveQL
days.lab_task: Create external tables over the raw logs, partition them by date, load a new day of data, and answer five business questions with HiveQL from Beeline.
checks: Queries for one day read only that partition
Dropping the table keeps the data files

days.topic: Hive File Formats: ORC, Parquet and Avro
days.lab_task: Convert the log tables from text to ORC and Parquet with compression, compare storage size and query times and choose a format for each layer.
checks: Storage size compared for each format
Query times compared for each format
Format chosen per layer with reasons

days.topic: Moving Data In and Out: DistCp, Kafka Connect and JDBC Imports
subtopics: Batch ingestion options after Sqoop's retirement
days.lab_task: Import a MySQL table into HDFS incrementally with Spark JDBC, stream events into HDFS with Kafka Connect and export results back to a database, validating row counts.
checks: Only new rows imported on the second run
Kafka events land in HDFS files

days.topic: Apache HBase for Random Reads and Writes
days.lab_task: Store user profiles in HBase with a row key design for fast lookups, run gets and scans, set time to live on a column family and compare access speed with Hive.
checks: Get by row key returns in milliseconds
Cells removed after their time to live

days.topic: Spark on YARN for Hadoop Users
subtopics: Why Spark replaced most MapReduce work
Reading and writing HDFS and Hive tables
Spark SQL over the Hive metastore
The Spark UI and history server
Converting a MapReduce job to Spark
days.lab_task: Rewrite the Java log job in Spark, run it on YARN reading Hive tables, compare run times and fix a container memory error.
checks: Spark job completes on the cluster
Container killed error fixed by tuning

days.topic: Workflow Scheduling with Oozie and Airflow
subtopics: Apache Airflow DAGs for Hadoop jobs
days.lab_task: Schedule the daily log pipeline in Oozie, rebuild it as an Airflow DAG with retries and alerts, and wait for the day's data before starting.
checks: Pipeline runs on schedule in both tools
Pipeline waits until the data arrives

days.topic: ZooKeeper and Coordination
subtopics: What ZooKeeper does for Hadoop services
ZooKeeper for HDFS and YARN high availability
days.lab_task: Run a three-node ZooKeeper ensemble, inspect the znodes used by HBase, stop one node to show the quorum still works and stop two to show it fails.
checks: Ensemble stops serving with two nodes down

days.topic: Hadoop Cluster Configuration and Core Settings
subtopics: Memory settings for YARN and containers
HDFS replication and block size settings
days.lab_task: Tune YARN memory for the lab nodes, change replication for one directory, roll out the configuration and restart services one by one without failing running jobs.
checks: Directory files use the new replication
Running jobs survive the rolling restart

days.topic: Monitoring Hadoop with Ambari or Cloudera Manager
days.lab_task: Add the lab cluster to a management tool, configure alerts for disk, NameNode and failed jobs, trigger each alert and write a daily health check.
checks: Alert raised when disk usage passes the threshold

days.topic: Hadoop Security: Kerberos, Ranger and Encryption in Brief
subtopics: Kerberos concepts: principals, keytabs and tickets
days.lab_task: Log in with Kerberos, create Ranger policies that limit a team to its own Hive database, set up an encryption zone and check the audit logs.
checks: Commands fail without a ticket and work with one
Team blocked from another team's database
Files in the zone unreadable without the key

days.topic: Querying with Impala, Trino or Hive LLAP
days.lab_task: Run the same reports on Hive, Impala or Trino, collect table statistics, compare response times and connect a BI tool to the fastest engine.
checks: Response times compared for five queries
Query plans improve after computing statistics
Dashboard reads data through the engine

days.topic: Hadoop in the Cloud: EMR, Dataproc and HDInsight
subtopics: When to move to a lakehouse instead
tools: Amazon EMR or Google Cloud Dataproc
days.lab_task: Run the log pipeline on a managed cluster reading from object storage, use a transient cluster that shuts down after the job and compare cost with the lab cluster.
checks: Pipeline completes on the managed service

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Log Analytics Pipeline on Hadoop
days.lab_task: Build a daily web log analytics pipeline that ingests, cleans and stores logs in ORC Hive tables, runs Spark reports, is scheduled with retries and secured with Ranger, then present results.
checks: Business questions answered from the reports
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one pipeline

intermediate.summary: For engineers and administrators running Hadoop in production. Covers HDFS high availability and federation, YARN schedulers, MapReduce and Hive performance, ACID tables, partitioning and bucketing, HBase row key design, streaming ingestion, Spark SQL over the metastore, Iceberg on Hadoop, Kerberos and Ranger, Atlas governance, capacity planning, upgrades, snapshots and DR, monitoring, the small files problem, Ozone and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has used HDFS, YARN, Hive and Spark on a cluster
Comfortable with Linux administration and SQL
outcomes: Run highly available, well-tuned Hadoop clusters
Model and tune large Hive, HBase and Iceberg tables
Secure, govern and protect cluster data

days.topic: HDFS High Availability and Federation
subtopics: Single points of failure in HDFS
days.lab_task: Configure NameNode high availability with journal nodes and automatic failover, kill the active NameNode during writes and confirm clients continue.

days.topic: YARN Schedulers: Capacity and Fair Scheduler
subtopics: Why queues matter on shared clusters
days.lab_task: Create queues for ETL, BI and data science teams with guaranteed and maximum capacity, enable preemption, and show each team gets its share under load.
checks: Each queue gets its guaranteed share under load
Preemption reclaims resources for a starved queue
Jobs land in the right queue automatically

days.topic: MapReduce Performance: Combiners, Partitioners and Compression
days.lab_task: Tune a slow MapReduce job with a combiner, a custom partitioner for skewed keys and output compression, and record the gains.
checks: Job faster with compressed map output

days.topic: Hive Performance: Tez, Vectorisation and Cost-Based Optimisation
days.lab_task: Speed up five slow Hive queries with statistics, vectorisation, better joins, partition pruning and a materialised view, and compare plans before and after.
checks: Plans change after statistics are computed
Query rewritten to use the view

days.topic: Hive Transactions and ACID Tables
days.lab_task: Build a customer dimension as an ACID table, apply daily changes with MERGE as a type 2 slowly changing dimension and run compaction.
checks: History rows created for changed customers

days.topic: Partitioning and Bucketing Strategy for Large Tables
days.lab_task: Redesign an over-partitioned table, add bucketing for a frequent join, sort data for range filters and measure query and metastore effects.
checks: Partition count reduced with no query slowdown
Join uses buckets without a full shuffle

days.topic: HBase Data Modelling and Row Key Design
days.lab_task: Design row keys for a time series workload that avoid hotspots, pre-split the table, add a Phoenix secondary index and load test the design.
checks: Secondary index query fast with Phoenix

days.topic: Kafka to HDFS and Hive Streaming Ingestion
subtopics: Kafka Connect HDFS and Hive sinks
Spark Structured Streaming to Hive tables
days.lab_task: Stream click events from Kafka into partitioned Hive tables with Spark Structured Streaming, handle late data, keep file sizes healthy and backfill a missed hour.
checks: Events queryable in Hive within minutes
Late events land in the right partition

days.topic: Spark SQL over Hive Metastore
subtopics: Reading and writing Hive tables from Spark
days.lab_task: Move three Hive ETL jobs to Spark SQL using the shared metastore, keep Ranger rules working, tune shuffle settings and compare run times.
checks: Hive and Spark read the same tables
Ranger rules enforced for Spark users
objectives: Use Spark with the Hive metastore

days.topic: Apache Iceberg on Hadoop
days.lab_task: Convert a Hive table to Iceberg, evolve its schema and partitioning without rewrites, query an old snapshot and run table maintenance.
checks: New partition scheme used without rewriting old data
Query returns data as of an earlier snapshot
Old snapshots expired and files compacted

days.topic: Securing a Cluster with Kerberos and Apache Ranger
subtopics: Ranger policies for HDFS, Hive and HBase
days.lab_task: Kerberise the cluster against Active Directory, create Ranger policies with row filters and column masks for a sales table and verify access for three user roles.
checks: Analysts see masked customer phone numbers
Regional users see only their region

days.topic: Data Governance with Apache Atlas
subtopics: Automatic lineage from Hive and Spark
days.lab_task: Capture lineage for the log pipeline, classify personal data columns, drive Ranger tag policies from Atlas tags and build a glossary for business terms.
checks: Lineage traced from raw logs to reports
PII columns tagged and protected by tag policy

days.topic: Capacity Planning and Storage Management for HDFS
days.lab_task: Forecast storage for two years, move cold data to an archive storage policy, rebalance the cluster and set team quotas.
checks: Cold data moved to archive storage
Disk usage evened out across nodes

days.topic: Cluster Upgrades and Rolling Restarts
subtopics: Rolling upgrades for HDFS and YARN
days.lab_task: Plan and run a minor version upgrade on the lab cluster with rolling restarts, test key jobs before and after, and document the rollback plan.
checks: Cluster upgraded while jobs keep running
Key jobs pass after the upgrade

days.topic: Backup, Snapshots and Disaster Recovery for HDFS
days.lab_task: Enable snapshots on key directories, recover a deleted table from a snapshot, replicate data to a DR cluster with DistCp and back up the metastore.
checks: Deleted data restored from a snapshot
DR cluster holds the latest data
Tables visible after a metastore restore

days.topic: Monitoring, Alerting and Log Management for Clusters
days.lab_task: Export NameNode, ResourceManager and HiveServer2 metrics to Prometheus, build Grafana dashboards, alert on key failures and track pipeline SLAs.
checks: HDFS, YARN and Hive health shown
Alert fires when a NameNode goes down

days.topic: Small Files Problem and Compaction
subtopics: Why small files hurt HDFS and the NameNode
Fixing the source of small files
days.lab_task: Find directories with millions of small files, compact them with Spark, change the streaming job to write bigger files and track NameNode object counts.
checks: File count reduced with the same data

days.topic: Apache Ozone Object Storage
subtopics: Replication and erasure coding in Ozone
days.lab_task: Create Ozone buckets, access them through the S3 API and from Spark, move a dataset from HDFS to Ozone and compare operations.
checks: Files uploaded and listed with an S3 client
Spark job reads data in Ozone

days.topic: Troubleshooting Failed Jobs and Slow Queries
days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix five broken or slow jobs covering memory, skew, Kerberos, metastore and HDFS problems, and write a short note for each fix.
checks: Each case has cause, fix and prevention

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Secure Data Lake on Hadoop
days.lab_task: Build a secure data lake with highly available HDFS, YARN queues, streaming and batch ingestion, Iceberg tables, Ranger policies, Atlas lineage, snapshots and monitoring, then present it.
checks: Batch and streaming data land in governed tables
Access, masking and audit work for three roles
NameNode failover handled with no data loss
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior big data engineers, administrators and architects. Covers NameNode and YARN internals, multi-tenant clusters, petabyte-scale performance, enterprise security architecture, Cloudera Data Platform, hybrid and cloud designs, migrating Hadoop to lakehouses, moving Hive tables to Iceberg and Delta, replacing MapReduce and Hive jobs with Spark, erasure coding, multi-site DR, cost comparisons, automation, governance at scale, combined real-time and batch designs, decommissioning, incident troubleshooting and platform strategy.
prerequisites: Several years running or building on Hadoop clusters
Strong Linux, networking and security knowledge
Experience with Spark and Hive in production
outcomes: Explain and tune Hadoop internals at scale
Architect secure, multi-tenant and hybrid big data platforms
Lead migrations from Hadoop to modern platforms
Make cost and strategy decisions for big data estates

days.topic: Hadoop Internals: NameNode Metadata, Edit Logs and Block Placement
days.lab_task: Inspect fsimage and edit logs with the offline viewers, estimate NameNode heap from object counts, test a custom block placement scenario and explain lease recovery.
checks: Files and blocks counted from the offline viewer
Lease recovery shown after a writer crash

days.topic: YARN Internals and Large-Scale Resource Management
days.lab_task: Enable ResourceManager recovery and test a restart under load, schedule GPU containers, configure node health checks and explain how federation spreads load.
checks: GPU containers allocated to GPU nodes
Bad node excluded by health checks

days.topic: Multi-Tenant Hadoop Clusters
days.lab_task: Design tenancy for five business units with queues, quotas, Ranger isolation and chargeback reports, and show one noisy tenant cannot harm others.
checks: Tenants cannot read each other's data
Other tenants keep their SLAs during a flood

days.topic: Performance Engineering for Petabyte-Scale Clusters
days.lab_task: Benchmark the cluster with TeraSort and DFSIO, find the bottleneck, tune NameNode RPC, shuffle and JVM settings and show the gains.

days.topic: Hadoop Security Architecture at Enterprise Scale
subtopics: Threat models for big data platforms
Encryption and key management with KMS
days.lab_task: Threat model an enterprise cluster, design Kerberos realms and trusts, central Ranger policies, encryption with key rotation and network zones, and run a review.
checks: Encryption keys rotated without data loss

days.topic: Cloudera Data Platform Architecture
subtopics: Data warehouse and data engineering services
days.lab_task: Design a CDP deployment for a bank with base clusters and data services, plan the upgrade from an older distribution and compare public and private options.

days.topic: Hybrid Hadoop: On-Premises and Cloud Together
days.lab_task: Design a hybrid platform that keeps sensitive data on-premises and bursts heavy jobs to cloud clusters, replicate approved data and keep security consistent.
checks: Heavy job runs in the cloud on replicated data
Same policies apply in both environments

days.topic: Migrating Hadoop Workloads to Cloud Lakehouses
subtopics: Target platforms: Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake and cloud services
days.lab_task: Assess a cluster's workloads, choose a target lakehouse, migrate one pipeline and its data, run old and new in parallel and validate results.
checks: Every workload classified with a migration path
Pipeline runs on the target platform

days.topic: Moving Hive Tables to Iceberg and Delta
days.lab_task: Migrate a set of Hive tables to Iceberg in place and to Delta by copy, update dependent jobs, compare performance and plan rollback.
checks: Iceberg table created without copying data
Dependent jobs run on the new tables

days.topic: Replacing MapReduce and Hive Jobs with Spark
days.lab_task: Convert three MapReduce jobs and three Hive scripts with UDFs to Spark, prove identical results with tests, tune them and retire the old versions.
checks: Outputs identical to the legacy jobs

days.topic: Erasure Coding and Storage Efficiency in HDFS
days.lab_task: Apply an erasure coding policy to cold data, measure storage savings and read performance, and test recovery after losing DataNodes.
checks: Storage use reduced for cold data
Data readable after losing nodes within tolerance

days.topic: Disaster Recovery Across Data Centres
days.lab_task: Design DR between two data centres, replicate data, metastore and policies, run a failover drill and measure recovery time against the objective.
checks: Workloads run in the second site

days.topic: Cost Analysis: Hadoop Compared with Cloud Platforms
subtopics: Total cost of ownership for clusters
Hardware, licences, staff and data centre costs
days.lab_task: Build a five-year cost comparison between running the cluster and moving workloads to a cloud lakehouse, including migration costs, and present a business case.
checks: Five-year costs for both options calculated

days.topic: Automating Cluster Operations
tools: Cloudera Manager API or Ambari API
days.lab_task: Automate node addition, configuration changes and health checks through the management API and Ansible, and add a script that restarts failed services safely.
checks: Change rolled out by the API

days.topic: Data Governance and Compliance at Scale
days.lab_task: Set up retention and deletion rules, a data quality programme and audit-ready lineage for a regulated dataset, and report governance metrics.

days.topic: Real-Time and Batch Together: Kafka, Spark and HBase Architectures
subtopics: Lambda and kappa architectures on Hadoop
Spark streaming to HBase and Hive
days.lab_task: Build a fraud signal system with streaming to HBase for real-time lookups and batch to Hive for reports, reprocess a day of data and check consistency between layers.
days.deliverable: Real-time and batch architecture with tests
checks: Reprocessed day matches the streaming results
Lag and freshness shown on a dashboard

days.topic: Decommissioning Hadoop Safely
days.lab_task: Plan the decommissioning of a cluster after migration with inventories, archives, user moves, retention checks and a shutdown order, and run a dry run on the lab.
checks: Every dataset and job accounted for
Shutdown order tested on the lab cluster

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Cluster Incidents
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: a NameNode heap crisis, a metastore outage, an expired keytab and a failing disk, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Big Data Platform Strategy
days.lab_task: Assess a company's Hadoop estate, compare keep, modernise and migrate options, build a three-year roadmap and present it to a mock leadership team.
checks: Options compared on cost, risk and value

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Hadoop to Lakehouse Migration Programme
days.lab_task: Run a migration programme for a large cluster: assess workloads, design the target lakehouse, migrate pilot pipelines with parity tests, plan DR and decommissioning and defend the business case.
days.deliverable: Assessment, architecture, pilot results and business case
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
